title: open-helplines JSON Schema
description: Schema for the open-helplines global mental health hotline registry. Data is CC0 1.0; schema and tooling are Apache-2.0.
$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. This schema is licensed under Apache 2.0; data files conforming to this schema (data/**/*.json) are published under CC0-1.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA in the repository root.

E164PhoneNumber.description: Phone number in E.164 format: '+' followed by 1-15 digits

IsoDate.description: Calendar date in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD

ServiceCategory.description: Primary service category of the helpline

ContactMethod.description: How users can reach the helpline

HelplineContact.description: A single contact endpoint for a helpline service

languages.description: BCP-47 language codes supported by this contact endpoint

hours.description: Operating hours in local time. Use '24/7' for round-the-clock service, otherwise a human-readable string (e.g. 'Mon–Fri 09:00–21:00 JST')

free.description: True if the service is free of charge for callers

anonymous.description: True if the caller can remain anonymous; false if identification is required

HelplineRecord.description: A single mental health helpline or crisis support service

$comment.description: Machine-readable annotation or SPDX identifier. Not displayed to end users.

local_name.description: Name in the local language. Omit if identical to 'name'.

secondary_categories.description: Additional categories if this service serves multiple populations

contacts.description: All available contact methods for this helpline. At least one required.

description.description: Short description of the service in English. Maximum 280 characters (one tweet).

verified_at.description: Date the record was last manually verified as operational. Must be within the past 24 months.

source.description: Authoritative source URL or citation for the data (e.g. official government page, Wikipedia with references)

government_backed.description: True if this service is officially endorsed or funded by a national or regional government

donate_url.description: Direct donation page for this helpline organization. Omit if the organization does not accept public donations.

tags.description: Additional searchable tags. Use lowercase hyphenated slugs.

HelplineDataFile.description: Shape of each country's helplines.json file (e.g. data/countries/jp/helplines.json)

$comment.description: SPDX-License-Identifier or other machine-readable annotation. Recommended: 'SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0'

records.description: All helpline records for this country

CountryIndex.description: One entry in the global index per country

data_files.description: Paths to JSON data files relative to repository root

record_count.description: Total number of HelplineRecord entries for this country

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the last data update

GlobalIndex.description: Shape of data/index.json — machine-generated global index

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema that produced this index

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this index was last rebuilt

countries.description: Index entry for each country in the registry

total_records.description: Total helpline records across all countries
